ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture has a food chain/energy flow schematic diagram. The sun on the right is labeled “solar energy,” the plants are labeled “producers,” the rabbit above is labeled “primary consumers,” beside the predator on the left that looks like a large feline animal is labeled “secondary consumers,” and the mushroom below is labeled “decomposers.” Then reason: carnivore refers to a meat-eating animal that eats other animals. In a food chain, predators that eat primary consumers belong to a higher-level consumer; the predator in the picture is labeled secondary consumers. Therefore, carnivore is secondary consumer.
